verdict.rationale: First-party support docs state that llamafile ships GPU acceleration for Apple Metal, and macOS and multiple CPU architectures are listed as supported, so the core of Metal-accelerated inference on Apple Silicon is documented. The evidence is a single thin line, and the native ARM side is only implied by the 'most CPU architectures' claim. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of native ARM/Apple Silicon CPU optimizations, in-depth Metal setup/performance docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration of Apple Silicon speedups.
